items.title: 7.7 Microwaves se stationary waves ka tajruba (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.7 with Fig. 7.10 and the microwave-oven box (PDF 156).

blocks.text: Microwaves electromagnetic radiation ki ek shakal hain. Inhein micro waves is liye kehte hain ke un ki wavelengths aam taur par millimetres ya centimetres ke darje ki hoti hain, radio waves se kahin chhoti. Stationary waves, jinhein standing waves bhi kehte hain, microwaves se tab banti hain jab woh kisi khaas ilaqe ya khoh (cavity), jaise wave guides ya resonant chambers, mein qaid hon; in mein microwaves aage peeche takra kar nodes aur antinodes wala standing wave pattern banati hain. Yeh tab hota hai jab microwave ki frequency cavity ki resonant frequency se mel khaye.

blocks.alt: Khula darwaza microwave oven. Labels: Magnetron produces microwaves (oopar baen), Metal wave-guide (oopar ke sath), Rotating stirrer (oopar daen), Food on turntable (neeche), Metal box to keep microwave inside, aur Window has fine metal mesh over it (darwaze par). Laal teer andar takrati microwaves dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Structure of Microwave Oven (PDF page 156): magnetron, wave-guide, stirrer, turntable par khana, dhaat ka dabba aur khirki (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magnetron microwaves banata hai; wave-guide unhein dabbe tak le jata hai; stirrer unhein bikherta hai. Dhaat ki deewarein aur khirki ki bareek jaali microwaves ko andar rakhti hain, aur andar stationary waves ban jati hain; turntable khane ko ghumata hai taake nodes par thanda na rahe.

Microwaves se stationary waves is saada tareeqe se banai ja sakti hain (Fig. 7.10). Tajrubati intezam mein microwave source (transmitter), probe detector aur metal reflector (microwaves lautane ke liye dhaat ki plate) ek seedh mein rakhe jate hain. Microwave source se nikalti waves metal plate ki taraf jati hain aur wapas laut aati hain; lautti wave aur aane wali wave superpose ho kar stationary wave pattern banati hain. Ise transmitter aur plate ke darmiyan rakhe probe detector se pakra ja sakta hai, aur detector signal ki shiddat (intensity) dekhta hai. Plate ya detector ko hila kar antinodes aur nodes dekhe ja sakte hain. Ek antinode se agle antinode ka faasla maloom kar ke stationary wave ki wavelength nikali ja sakti hai: padosi antinodes aadhi wavelength door hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf horn wala microwave source daen taraf metal reflector ki taraf lehrein bhejta hai; darmiyan thos aur dashed curves stationary wave dikhate hain. Beech mein stand par probe detector hai jo CRO se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.10: Microwave se stationary waves ka tajrubati intezam (kitab ki Figure 7.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Reflector se palti lehar aane wali lehar se mil kar stationary wave banati hai; reflector par node hai. Probe ko lakeer ke sath chalayein to CRO par signal antinode par sab se tez aur node par sifar hota hai. Do antinodes ka faasla lambda/2 hai, is se wavelength nikalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Microwave tajrube mein padosi antinodes 1.4 cm door milte hain; wavelength aur frequency kya hai? Microwaves ki aam frequency range kya hai (MCQ 7.10)?
blocks.explanation: Padosi antinodes aadhi wavelength door hain, to lambda = 2 x 1.4 = 2.8 cm = 0.028 m, aur f = c/lambda = 3 x 10^8 / 0.028 = 1.1 x 10^10 Hz. Microwaves taqreeban 10^9 Hz aur 10^11 Hz ke darmiyan hain, option (d).

items: Microwaves: electromagnetic, wavelength mm se cm; cavities ya wave guides mein qaid ho kar standing waves banati hain. Source, probe detector aur metal reflector ek seedh mein: aane wali aur lautti waves nodes aur antinodes banati hain; antinodes ka faasla wavelength deta hai (lambda = 2 x faasla). Oven: magnetron, wave-guide, stirrer, turntable, dhaat ka dabba aur jaali wali khirki.
